title: Day 787: 28-Year-Old Shot Dead Inside Motorcycle Workshop in Escuinapa's Pueblo Nuevo Neighborhood
detail: Around 2:44 AM on Friday, September 18, 2026, residents of Río Quelite street in the Pueblo Nuevo neighborhood of Escuinapa reported hearing multiple gunshots. Responding authorities found a 28-year-old man, identified as Damián, dead inside a motorcycle repair workshop with several gunshot wounds; a black motorcycle was found next to his body. No arrests were reported. The killing was the first of four homicides recorded across Sinaloa that day.

title: Day 787: Ride-Share Passenger Shot Dead Near Elementary School in Culiacán's Fovissste Humaya
detail: At approximately 9:15 AM on Friday, September 18, 2026, a 34-year-old man identified as Jesús Gilberto, a resident of the Lomas de Guadalupe neighborhood, was riding as a rear passenger in a white Renault ride-share vehicle at the intersection of Dr. Enrique Cabrera and SARH streets in the Fovissste Humaya neighborhood, north Culiacán — a few meters from a primary school. A motorcyclist pulled alongside the car and fired directly at him, killing him at the scene; the driver was unharmed. Reports indicated Jesús Gilberto had requested the ride from the Las Vegas neighborhood after being summoned to the location by another person.

media.caption: Investigators at the scene where ride-share passenger Jesús Gilberto was shot dead in Culiacán's Fovissste Humaya neighborhood, September 18, 2026

title: Day 787: Man Shot Dead on Sofa During Family Gathering in Villa Unión Home
detail: At 2:50 PM on Friday, September 18, 2026, armed men arrived at a home on Calle 20 de Noviembre in Villa Unión, Mazatlán, where a 41-year-old man identified as Julián 'N' was resting on a sofa during a family gathering. An occupant of a red vehicle got out, entered the residence and opened fire without warning, killing him, before fleeing with the others. No arrests were reported.
